name: EPIC 201467145
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 6.4 solar radii and 0.84 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201467145 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM radius (solar radii) 6.398499 (16th-84th percentiles 6.243242-6.602555), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201467145 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.843976 (16th-84th percentiles 0.795253-0.91089), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201467145: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4829.428 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201467145 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 1854.492188 (16th-84th percentiles 1814.550781-1901.171875), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.06 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 1,855 parsecs away, 6 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.84 solar masses and 6.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,829 K at its surface.
